headings.chapter: CUSTOS Interlude II: Notices of the Office of Records and Accommodation

edits.old: at eleven at night on the last day of January
edits.new: at eleven at night on the sixteenth of February
edits.why: the harbour night is the run's night: 16 February (Day 77)

edits.old: the Connacht Tribune of the 22nd of February
edits.new: the Connacht Tribune of the twelfth of February
edits.why: Mesa wrote the forty-one names on that newspaper during the run on the night of the sixteenth, so the paper cannot be dated after it; the twelfth is the Thursday before, which is the Connacht Tribune's publication day
the bulletin that closes Ch 18 now falls inside the chapter (Days 71–82), on the morning after the landing

edits.old: She put the question properly on the seventy-first day
edits.new: She put the question properly on the eighty-fifth day
edits.why: the question is put two days before the rescue, which is now the Thursday of the last week of February

edits.old: The bulletin changed on the seventy-seventh day
edits.new: The bulletin changed on the eighty-ninth day
edits.why: the order takes effect on 1 March (Day 90), so the bulletin that announces it goes out the day before

edits.old: On the seventy-ninth day they stopped hiding the number
edits.new: On the ninety-first day they stopped hiding the number

edits.old: The Galway case came up on the eighty-first day
edits.new: The Galway case came up on the ninety-third day

edits.old: The register page came back on the eighty-second day
edits.new: The register page came back on the ninety-fourth day

edits.old: it was the reason the seventy-ninth day was the day the crew stopped arguing
edits.new: it was the reason the ninety-first day was the day the crew stopped arguing
edits.why: one of two cross-references to this day (the other is in Ch 27)

edits.old: The delegation came on the eighty-fourth day
edits.new: The delegation came on the ninety-fifth day

edits.old: We have three weeks and one day.
edits.why: the vault collection is 16 March (Day 105) and this scene is now Day 95 (6 March)
cross-reference to the Martial Law day, carried with it

edits.old: It is February and I am sixty-eight
edits.new: It is March and I am sixty-eight
edits.why: the Crane doorstep has moved behind the arrest, into the first week of March

edits.old: The application went on the ninety-first day.
edits.new: The application went on the ninety-seventh day.

edits.old: on the ninety-sixth day he read one
edits.new: on the hundredth day he read one
edits.why: the Killybegs lamp entry reaches the notices three weeks after the entry itself

edits.old: They went on the ninety-seventh day
edits.new: They went on the hundred and first day

edits.old: After the interview at the western facility on the eighteenth of February
edits.new: After the interview at the western facility on the second of March
edits.why: Mesa is not taken until Friday 27 February, so the interview cannot be 18 February

edits.old: a person was interviewed at the western facility on the eighteenth of February
edits.new: a person was interviewed at the western facility on the second of March
